variables.input:
timeseries avg(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_success, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }), by: { service }
| fields service

timeseries avg(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_success, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) }), by: { ns }
| fields ns

0.content: **LRU Cache View**: For namespaces used as a cache: touches, throughput, objects and expirations. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

2.title: Total (rate)
2.query:
timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_success, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a1 = sum(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_error, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a2 = sum(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_tsvc_error, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a3 = sum(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_skip, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a4 = sum(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_timeout, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a5 = sum(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_tsvc_timeout, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s)
| fieldsAdd success = a0[], error = (a1[] + a2[]), skip = a3[], timeout = (a4[] + a5[])
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5
| fields success = coalesce(success[-2], arrayLast(success)), error = coalesce(error[-2], arrayLast(error)), skip = coalesce(skip[-2], arrayLast(skip)), timeout = coalesce(timeout[-2], arrayLast(timeout))
2.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum(rate(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_success{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", ns=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_error{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", ns=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum(rate(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_tsvc_error{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", ns=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum(rate(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_skip{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", ns=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_timeout{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", ns=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum(rate(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_tsvc_timeout{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", ns=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

3.content:
### Ratio : Touch vs Reads

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (arithmetic between series that are already summarized, sorted or counted). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
sum(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_success{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", ns=~"$namespace"}) / sum((aerospike_namespace_batch_sub_read_success{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", ns=~"$namespace"} != 0) + (aerospike_namespace_client_read_success{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", ns=~"$namespace"} !=0))
```

4.title: Objects (total)
4.query:
timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_namespace_master_objects, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg), a1 = sum(aerospike_namespace_expired_objects, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) })
| fieldsAdd master = a0[], expired = a1[]
| fieldsRemove a0, a1
| fields master = coalesce(master[-2], arrayLast(master)), expired = coalesce(expired[-2], arrayLast(expired))
4.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum(aerospike_namespace_master_objects{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"})
sum(aerospike_namespace_expired_objects{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"})

5.description:

| fieldsAdd read_touch_success = a0[], read_client_batch_success = (a1[] + a2[]), read_client_batch_not_found = (a3[] + a4[])
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2, a3, a4

Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum (rate(aerospike_namespace_read_touch_success{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum (rate(aerospike_namespace_client_read_success{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(aerospike_namespace_batch_sub_read_success{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum (rate(aerospike_namespace_client_read_not_found{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(aerospike_namespace_batch_sub_read_not_found{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}[$__rate_interval]))
